name: Inmarsat
best_known_for: Geostationary mobile satellite comms — 14+ satellites at GEO providing maritime, aviation, and remote-area voice + data; backbone of GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System)
credit: Viasat-owned Inmarsat constellation (acquired 2023). Originally founded 1979 as International Maritime Satellite Organization, an intergovernmental treaty body.
